part.text:
Implemented generic/native path formatting in `include/fmt/std.h`:

- `parse` now accepts a `type` of `g` (generic) or `n` (native) after alignment/width/`?` (include/fmt/std.h:105-110)
- `format` uses `p.generic_string<path::value_type>()` for `{:g}` (forward slashes cross-platform) and `p.native()` for default/`{:n}` (include/fmt/std.h:118-121)

Verified: `std-test` (13 tests, including the new `{:n}`/`{:g}` cases and Windows-path equivalents) and `xchar-test` (36 tests) all pass in the container.
